nodes.title: ChIRP-Seq
nodes.scope: Illumina explanatory ChIRP schematic, specifically the RNA-directed chromatin capture to genomic-DNA readout path supported by Chu et al. (PMID 21963238). ChIRP is the capture method and ChIRP-seq its sequencing readout; the card uses the names interchangeably. The image ends at extracted DNA; broad library construction and sequencing/genomic localization are explicitly marked text-supported extensions. The related dChIRP publication (PMID 24997788) establishes a distinct domain-level variant only at abstract level; its implementation is not assigned the depicted operations. Protein/RNA assay branches from the primary paper, early morpholino optimization and catalogue kit names are not depicted workflows and are not added. No origin/priority or equivalence to other capture methods is asserted.
